componentPlan.focusQuote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Traces halving steps on sorted arrays to show how the interval narrows toward the key.
Checks facts about run time, safe midpoint form and ordered list behavior.

overview.headline: Binary search on sorted arrays with safe midpoint calculation

keyPoints.point: Students learn that binary search operates on a sorted array by dividing the search interval in half.
keyPoints.quote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

keyPoints.point: Students learn to narrow the interval to the lower half or upper half using the search key and middle item.
keyPoints.quote: If the value of the search key is less than the item in the middle of the interval, narrow the interval to the lower half.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that binary search only performs logarithmic comparisons while traversing linked structures.
keyPoints.quote: but it only performs O(log n) comparisons.

keyPoints.point: Students learn why midpoint calculation overflows for large integer values near limits.
keyPoints.quote: This overflows if high and low are close to the largest expressible integer.

keyTerms.gloss: Ordered collection divided in half to narrow the search interval
keyTerms.quote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

keyTerms.gloss: Value compared with the middle item to choose the lower interval
keyTerms.quote: If the value of the search key is less than the item in the middle of the interval, narrow the interval to the lower half.

keyTerms.gloss: Range covering array positions that is divided during search
keyTerms.quote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

keyTerms.gloss: Central position in the interval used to narrow the search range
keyTerms.quote: If the value of the search key is less than the item in the middle of the interval, narrow the interval to the lower half.
